items.html: And behold, something similar to this is also in particular — that is, also in each and every world of the four worlds it was in this manner. For when the aspect of the world of Atzilut was being sorted, at first was sorted the particular discernment that is of the portion of Atik Yomin of Atzilut; afterward the one inferior to it was sorted in AA; afterward the one inferior to it was sorted in Aba and Ima; afterward the one inferior to it, in ZON; and afterward, in this manner, all the parts of BYA went on being sorted.
